metadata.case_name: TSUI WAI HO v. PRIDE GLORY LTD FORMERLY T/A ZITI'S

injuries.description: Tenderness, bruises and swollen left ankle
Mild pain in left leg from time to time, especially when there is change of weather

losses.description: Left ankle fracture with open reduction and internal fixation, implant removal surgery
Limited range of movement initially, required crutches, difficulty with stairs and prolonged walking
Could not resume part-time delivery work; disadvantaged in labour market for jobs requiring prolonged walking or strenuous exertion

losses.category: Loss of ability to pursue education
losses.description: Delayed start of Yijin Course by one month (from Sept 2013 to Oct 2013)

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Temporary inability to engage in physical activities during recovery period

losses.category: Loss of holidays or special occasions
losses.description: Rest at home for about 1 month after discharge

comparable_cases.case_name: Chan Mok Yau v. 黃吉利 and Another
comparable_cases.injury_description: Right ankle fracture, conservative treatment by cast, 424 days sick leave, moderately reduced range of movement almost 2 years after accident

comparable_cases.case_name: Lam Kam Fai v. Yau Shing Scaffolding Co Ltd
comparable_cases.injury_description: Left ankle fracture, surgery, removal of implant, physiotherapy, full range of movement, pre-existing old injury to left ankle

comparable_cases.case_name: Leung See Ning Clara v. Shun Tak Property Management Ltd
comparable_cases.injury_description: Left ankle fracture, open reduction and internal fixation, discharged 11 days after accident, occasional mild pain on follow-up, implant removal 2.5 years after accident, 8.5cm scar

comparable_cases.case_name: Kwong Wan Kau v. Yuen Wing Hong
comparable_cases.injury_description: Right ankle fracture, operation with metal implants, hospitalized 11 days, physiotherapy for more than one year, occupational therapy for about 14 months, removal of implants 6 months after accident, sick leave for more than 3 years
